$comment: TEST FIXTURE — not the game roster. Ten invented characters with short, readable ids so engine tests read clearly and, more importantly, so the rules tests do not break when the *game* roster changes. Rules are not roster data; coupling them was a mistake this file corrects.

characters.name: The Anvil
characters.blurb: Placeholder. Absorbs pressure and gives ground slowly.

characters.name: The Cartographer
characters.blurb: Placeholder. Trades early tempo for board knowledge.

characters.name: The Duelist
characters.blurb: Placeholder. High variance, decides rounds quickly.

characters.name: The Magpie
characters.blurb: Placeholder. Takes what the opponent leaves behind.

characters.name: The Sentinel
characters.blurb: Placeholder. Denies options rather than creating them.

characters.name: The Vagrant
characters.blurb: Placeholder. No strong suit, no weak one either.
